name: @240xu/dsh-message-ops
description: DSH web plugin: message rollback + delete + branch + Markdown export + restore-replay + a message_ops agent tool, in one plugin. Revert/delete use DSH-native surface replace (append-only, recoverable); branch forks a session from any message into a new session with parentSession linkage. Zero npm dependencies (node:zlib zstd) — Windows / Termux / Linux alike.
author: 240xu
